filesToTouch.what: One self-contained Vitest characterisation file. NO production code changes anywhere — pure L2-fixture test. Structure: (A) SYNTHETIC MANIFEST as in-file consts with real object identity (within references the group OBJECT, exactly like sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/commodities/identifiers.js): `lines` group { id: <fresh literal UUID>, name: 'lines', requires: { minEntries: 1, errorCode: 'obligation.lines.required' } }; `lineLabel` { id, name: 'lineLabel', status: 'mandatory', within: lines }; `species` group { id, name: 'species', within: lines, requires: { minEntries: 1, errorCode: 'obligation.species.required' } }; `speciesCode` { id, name: 'speciesCode', status: 'mandatory', within: species }; `varieties` group { id, name: 'varieties', within: species } (optional — NO requires); `varietyName` { id, name: 'varietyName', status: 'mandatory', within: varieties }; `varietyGrade` { id, name: 'varietyGrade', status: 'mandatory', within: varieties, applyTo: allowListed(speciesCode, gradedSpecies, varieties, [reason]) } where gradedSpecies = () => ['GRADED'] and reason is a { code, explanation } object — a depth-2 gate value projecting onto depth-3 instances, one level deeper than the identifiers.js exemplar (allowListed imported from ../model/obligations/helpers/index.js). Manifest namespace object: { obligations: [all 7], groups: obligations.filter((o) => obligations.some((other) => other.within === o)) (the derived formula, never hand-kept), policy: { systemPopulated: [], enforcedAtContinue: [], maxEntriesFrom: {}, systemAnswerKeys: [] } } — policy included in FD-7 shape so the file is green both before and after pp-005 (P-1) lands (ignored today; empty-safe after). (B) SYNTHETIC BINDINGS mirroring sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/evaluation.js:26-38: descriptors lineD = { field: 'lines', token: 'line', obligation: lines }, speciesD = { field: 'species', token: 'species', obligation: species }, varietyD = { field: 'varieties', token: 'variety', obligation: varieties }; bindings = feature('depth-three-fixture', [ grouped({ field: 'lineLabel', obligation: lineLabel, groups: [lineD] }), grouped({ field: 'speciesCode', obligation: speciesCode, groups: [lineD, speciesD] }), grouped({ field: 'varietyName', obligation: varietyName, groups: [lineD, speciesD, varietyD] }), grouped({ field: 'varietyGrade', obligation: varietyGrade, groups: [lineD, speciesD, varietyD] }) ]) (feature/grouped from ./fulfilment-bindings.js). (C) SINGLETON RECONFIGURATION in beforeAll, overriding test/setup-obligation-set.js's live-animals wiring for THIS file only (Vitest per-file worker isolation — FD-10; precedent: src/server/app/store-ops.test.js:30-40): configureObligationSet(syntheticManifest); configureFulfilmentRegistry(bindings); buildDispatch([{ id: 'depth-three-page', slug: 'depth-three', collects: ['lines'] }]); configureRecords(recordsStub from services/persistence/records/stub/index.js); configureSession(sessionStub from services/persistence/session/stub.js); beforeEach: await store.clear(); journeyId = (await store.create()).journeyId (store from engine/store.js; journeyRequest/stubH from engine/test-support.js). (D) SIX TEST BLOCKS: [1] grouped-binding REGISTRATION at depth 3 — configureFulfilmentRegistry accepts the 3-chain; fulfilmentRegistry.groupDescriptorOf(varietyName.id) surfaces the chain; ownerOf resolves; NEGATIVE: creating a registry binding varietyName with groups [lineD, speciesD] (depth 2, disagreeing with the within chain) throws — pin the diagnostic message. [2] DISPATCH COVERAGE INHERITANCE — buildDispatch succeeds with ONLY 'lines' in collects (no uncovered-obligation rejection); pageOfObligation(speciesCode.id), pageOfObligation(varietyName.id) and pageOfObligation(varietyGrade.id) all resolve to 'depth-three-page' (member inherits owner from the NEAREST ANCESTOR group); slugOfPage/collectsOf sanity (flow/dispatch.js exports). [3] ASSEMBLY + EVALUATION at depth 3 — assembleFulfilments (bridge/assemble-fulfilments.js) over answers { lines: [{ lineLabel, species: [{ speciesCode, varieties: [{ varietyName, varietyGrade }] }] }] }: positional composite fulfilment ids at depth 3 (expected 'line0/species0/variety0' from the tokens — characterise the observed format on first run); evaluateAnswers (bridge/evaluation.js): lines minEntries floor violated when lines empty; species floor violated per line with no species; a species with NO varieties array is NOT incomplete (varieties group optional). [4] STORE OPS at ['lines', i, 'species', j, 'varieties'] — via appendEntryAt/updateEntryAt/removeEntryAt from engine/index.js with journeyRequest(journeyId)/stubH(), seeding parents with store.seedAnswers (transpose store-ops.test.js depth-1 block to the depth-3 path): append mints indices 0,1 and persists; updateEntryAt edits one variety in place leaving siblings at ALL THREE levels intact; removeEntryAt splices only the target; non-integer and out-of-range TARGET index ignored (store-ops parity); PLUS pin the out-of-range PARENT-index behaviour at BOTH ancestor levels (e.g. append at ['lines', 5, 'species', 0, 'varieties'] and ['lines', 0, 'species', 9, 'varieties']) — CHARACTERISE observed behaviour, do not fix: if the primitives fabricate phantom parent instances that matches recipe §4.7's documented expectation (controller-side guards are the mitigation) and is pinned as the contract, NOT treated as a red. [5] PER-INSTANCE SCOPE + WIPE at depth 3 — seed line0 with speciesCode 'GRADED' and line1 with 'UNGRADED', both carrying varieties with varietyName + varietyGrade values; evaluation.fulfilments carries varietyGrade only under line0's variety keys (allowListed projection through the varieties group at depth 3); wipeSet(fulfilments, evaluation) (bridge/purge.js) removes ONLY line1's varietyGrade positional values — varietyName in the same instance and line0's varietyGrade survive (field-level wipe within an instance, exact scope-and-wipe contract). [6] COLLECTION-COMPLETE ROLLUP — entryComplete(evaluation, ['lines', 0, 'species', 0, 'varieties'], k) (bridge/collection-complete.js) per variety instance: missing varietyName => false, full => true; collectionView at the depth-3 path returns facts-only [{ index, path, entry, complete }] with entry as the SAME store reference (collection-complete.test.js:76-91 pattern); rollup: a line entry is complete only when its species floor is met and every nested instance is complete; a fully-empty variety instance is never enumerated so it cannot fire (pin the depth-3 analogue of collection-complete.test.js:112). House test style: behaviour-only assertions (no toHaveBeenCalled), 'Should …' names, no explanatory comments beyond what pins a contract.
